headline: Fresh zero-day exploit code for Windows and Siemens switches lands as attackers turn hidden text and voice-cloning scripts against AI security defenses.

emerging_trends.text: Attackers keep turning the machinery of AI against its own defenses, hiding text salting inside phishing emails to slip past LLM filters and scripting voice-cloning calls that convince people to reset passwords.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Salted Emails and Voice Scripts Slip Past AI Defenses

emerging_trends.text: Speed now defines the most dangerous threats, with Spirals ransomware racing from break-in to full network encryption in under 24 hours and public exploit code landing on fully patched Windows machines.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Spirals Ransomware Encrypts Networks in Under 24 Hours

emerging_trends.text: Governments on both sides of the Atlantic are moving against platform power, as the European Commission forces Google to open Android and San Francisco orders AI nudify apps off the app stores.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Regulators Press Google, TikTok, and AI Nudify Apps

topics.title: New Zero-Day Exploits Hit Windows, Siemens, and n8n
topics.latest_developments: A researcher using the handle Nightmare Eclipse published a working Windows zero-day exploit called LegacyHive that escalates privileges to administrator on fully patched systems, Palo Alto Networks' Unit 42 chained three zero-days in Siemens ROX II OT switches to win persistent root, and n8n disclosed a JWT flaw that logs Enterprise users in as accounts belonging to a different token issuer.
topics.summary: LegacyHive abuses the Windows User Profile Service, the Siemens ROX II trilogy grants privilege escalation and root on industrial switches, and n8n's multi-issuer instances matched incoming tokens on the sub claim alone while ignoring iss. Patch each product and restrict exposure.

sources.title: New Windows LegacyHive zero-day gives hackers admin privileges
Three Steps to the Terminal: A Siemens ROX II Zero-Day Trilogy
n8n Token Exchange Flaw Could Let Attackers Log In as Users From Another Issuer

topics.title: Salted Emails and Voice Scripts Slip Past AI Defenses
topics.latest_developments: Dark Reading detailed how more than a million phishing emails hide characters through text salting to fool AI and LLM security filters into passing them to inboxes, researchers at Harvard Kennedy School and Meta found that a convincing script drives AI voice-phishing success across six commercial systems tested on 4,100 US adults, and 1Password shipped a beta letting Anthropic's Claude complete authenticated browser tasks without seeing user credentials.
topics.summary: Attackers exploit LLM filters' blind spots with hidden characters while agent makers scramble to contain credential exposure days after the Claude for Chrome extension flaw. Treat AI-driven filtering and browsing agents as porous.

sources.title: 1M+ Emails Use Hidden Text to Dupe AI Security Filters
The script, not the voice, is what makes AI voice phishing work
Claude can now sign into websites with 1Password without exposing your credentials

topics.title: Regulators Press Google, TikTok, and AI Nudify Apps
topics.latest_developments: The European Commission ordered Google to give rival AI assistants the same Android reach Gemini enjoys—camera, microphone, on-screen content, and background app control—by the Android 18 release, San Francisco's City Attorney sent Apple and Google cease-and-desist letters demanding they pull 13 AI nudify face-swap apps, and Britain's Ofcom opened an investigation into TikTok over alleged age-verification lapses.
topics.summary: The three actions show regulators tightening control over how large platforms handle AI access, child safety, and abusive apps. Google, TikTok, Apple, and the app-store owners face binding deadlines and legal demands.

sources.title: E.U. Orders Google to Open Android Mic, Camera and Screen to Rival AI Assistants
San Francisco Demands Apple and Google Delete AI 'Nudify' Apps From App Stores
UK investigates TikTok for alleged age-verification lapses, exposing kids to online harms

topics.title: US Charges Fraud Launderers as Armenia Detains a REvil Suspect
topics.latest_developments: US prosecutors charged a New York man and woman with laundering $43 million stolen through cyber investment-fraud scams, while Armenia has held Russian tourist Aleksandr Ermakov since June 28 on a US extradition request tied to a REvil ransomware suspect of the same name, whose lawyers say authorities have the wrong man.
topics.summary: The two cases show law enforcement pressing both the money-laundering networks behind investment fraud and the individuals tied to ransomware crews. Ermakov's wife, Maria Yurova, and his lawyers dispute the identification.

sources.title: US charges two over laundering $43 million from investment fraud
Armenia Detains Russian Tourist on U.S. Warrant for REvil Hacker, Lawyers Say Wrong Man

topics.title: Spirals Ransomware Encrypts Networks in Under 24 Hours
topics.latest_developments: Symantec's Threat Hunter Team documented Spirals, a previously unknown Rust-based ransomware strain that last month struck an IT services company in South Asia, moving from initial access through data theft to full network encryption in under 24 hours.
topics.summary: Spirals encrypts each file with a separate AES-128 key and wraps every key with attacker-controlled ECDH, running fast once it gains a foothold. Its speed leaves defenders little time to detect and respond before encryption completes.

sources.title: Spirals ransomware locks down victim systems in under 24 hours

business_politics.title: Burnham Becomes Britain's Prime Minister
business_politics.latest_developments: Andy Burnham was crowned Labour leader Friday, July 17, and enters Downing Street as prime minister Monday, pledging to govern as "pro-business" and to steady markets.
business_politics.summary: Andy Burnham, the former mayor of Manchester who joined parliament only last month, takes office Monday as Britain's prime minister and Labour leader, and his first task is calming bond and mortgage markets that lenders have already jolted with fixed-rate rises after renewed Middle East hostilities.

sources.title: Burnham promises to be 'pro-business' as he is crowned Labour leader
The U.K. Gets Another New Leader on Monday. His First Task: Reassure the Markets.

business_politics.title: Global Chip Selloff Deepens as AI Trade Reverses
business_politics.latest_developments: The AI-driven rout deepened Friday, July 17, with Netflix sliding on a weak-growth warning and IBM reeling from a 25% plunge, pushing the U.S. semiconductor index toward its worst week since 2025's "liberation day" selloff.
business_politics.summary: Investors kept fleeing chipmakers and AI-linked shares Friday—Tokyo's Nikkei 225 fell nearly 5%, Nasdaq futures dropped, gold slid, and Treasury yields fell as money sought safety—amid spreading doubt about the pace and payoff of the artificial-intelligence buildout.

sources.title: Global tech stocks fall as AI trade goes into reverse
U.S. Stock Futures Lower as Chip Selloff Deepens

business.title: U.S. Steel Touts Edgar Thomson Investment at Open House
business.latest_developments: U.S. Steel held an open house Thursday, July 16, to spotlight its planned plant investment, timing that drew scrutiny as wildfire smoke pushed the Mon Valley to a Code Purple air-quality alert.
business.summary: U.S. Steel, now owned by Nippon Steel, used the open house to promote its multibillion-dollar reinvestment in the Edgar Thomson works in Braddock, the pledge that helped clear the Nippon takeover, even as smoke choked the surrounding Monongahela River communities.

sources.title: As air quality issues take center stage, U.S. Steel's open house puts focus on new investment

business.title: Casino Revenue Funds Westmoreland Projects
business.latest_developments: TribLive detailed Friday, July 17, how Westmoreland County's 65 municipalities will spend the $17.2 million in Local Share Account money—renovating infrastructure, replacing police vehicles, and funding stormwater and sewer repairs.
business.summary: The state-mandated Local Share Account, funded by Live! Casino gambling revenue, distributed more than $17.2 million to Westmoreland County's 65 municipalities and organizations, money state Sen. Joe Pittman said many communities could not otherwise raise for critical repairs.

sources.title: Casino revenue delivers $17.2M for Westmoreland community projects

around_town.title: Smoke Shutters Kennywood, Idlewild, Sandcastle
around_town.latest_developments: Kennywood, Sandcastle, and Idlewild all closed Friday, July 17, and outdoor events across Western Pennsylvania were canceled as the statewide Code Purple alert held, with relief expected from Saturday's storms.
around_town.summary: Wildfire smoke from Canada and Minnesota drove all of Pennsylvania to a Code Purple "very unhealthy" air-quality alert Friday, closing the Kennywood, Sandcastle, and Idlewild parks and forcing region-wide cancellations; forecasters expect Saturday storms to wash the haze out.

sources.title: Kennywood, Sandcastle and Idlewild all closed due to Code Purple Air Quality Alert
Wildfire smoke in Pennsylvania: What's closed in the Pittsburgh region?

around_town.title: Free Ride Bicycle Collective Turns 25
around_town.latest_developments: Free Ride Bicycle Collective marked its 25th year with an alleycat ride and announced a "black jorts gala" for later this year.
around_town.summary: Free Ride Bicycle Collective, a Pittsburgh co-op that teaches residents to repair and ride bicycles and earn a bike through volunteer hours, celebrated a quarter century of getting the city into the saddle.

sources.title: Free Ride Bicycle Collective marks 25 years of getting Pittsburgh into the saddle

team_usa.title: Heaps Returns Home to Denver Summit FC
team_usa.latest_developments: ESPN reported U.S. women's national team midfielder Lindsey Heaps has transferred to NWSL expansion side Denver Summit FC, a homecoming to Colorado.
team_usa.summary: Lindsey Heaps, the USWNT midfielder whose career took her to Paris Saint-Germain and across Europe, has joined new NWSL club Denver Summit FC in a return to her native Colorado, she and her family told ESPN.

sources.title: After globetrotting with USWNT, PSG and more, Lindsey Heaps returns home
